reason: Project lens, checked in the source: no PROTECTED or GENERATED line (render.6502 is neither; PROTECT covers only game.6502's irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242 and &0004-&001E). No data moves and no new RAM: wa_off stays SKIP 2 in ren_zp; wa_off+1 is written only by the deleted STA (grep of src/ and tools/ finds no reader; its other mentions are comments on X holding it), so dropping the store changes no byte anything reads. dm_index is written only at render.6502 1321 (put_on.going_on) and both JMP record_live sites (1328-1332 sky path, 1385-1396 masked path) run LDY dm_index first; nothing else (sky_put_on, draw_mover, kc_*, world_of_address, the interrupt) writes it (ren_zp: renderer only, decision 34), so Y restored from it equals the PHY/PLY value in shipping, SKY_HELI=0 and DEBUG_FULLREDRAW builds. Paging: record_live runs in bank 4 with ANDY in or out; its new reads (movers_screen_address_high,X at &13xx main RAM, screen_start_address_lo/hi zero page, dm_index zero page) are below &3000, so ACCCON's X bit does not change what they read, and it reads one table fewer (movers_screen_address_low,X dropped). Carry: SEC/SBC low/STA wa_off/LDA high,X/STA rec_sh,Y/SBC high: LDA and STA leave C, so the borrow reaches the high SBC as before; A at wa_hi_done_c1 = (high - start_high - borrow) & &3F as at the old TAX. Exit A, X (from world_of_address), Y, flags (from LDA wa_y) unchanged; tools/worldcheck.mjs reads cpu.y at the RTS between record_live and world_of_address, still the record index. No entries past world_of_address's start (grep 'world_of_address' in src/: only render.6502's two JSRs); list_live goes through the unchanged first half. The scope.label form is in use (put_on.going_on, mark_part.header_lo). Room: +2 bytes in bank 4; listings' PAD_END ends below REN_BASE &B400 by 131 (ship), 10 (gameplay, &B3F6), 7 (DEBUG_FULLREDRAW, &B3F9), 60 (gameplay_* without hud_rupture), so every build still fits; the ASSERT would catch it otherwise. Behaviour: the records hold the same bytes, so the same game, screen and sound on every path (front end, helicopter, game over, completion do not reach different code here). Recount: record_live path old LDA abs,X 4 + STA abs,Y 5 + PHY 3 + LDY abs,X 4 + TAX 2 + TYA 2 + JSR 6 + SEC 2 + SBC zp 3 + STA zp 3 + TXA 2 + SBC zp 3 + AND 2 + STA zp 3 + PLY 4 = 48; new SEC 2 + SBC 3 + STA 3 + LDA 4 + STA 5 + SBC 3 + AND 2 + JSR 6 + LDY zp 3 = 31: 17 saved; list_live path 3 (the dead STA zp); 20 per pair of executions as claimed. Bytes: -9 +11 = +2 (the claim's -2 is the saving's sign, i.e. 2 bytes larger). Table slide of wa_rows_guess (&A0F5 -> &A0F7, a page cross for X 9-10) is a machine/measurement matter the gate's pcprof settles.
